results.detail: All four CTest executables passed, including hibiki_contract_tests fixtures for same-group attached-to-attached loudness PEQ replacement: the transition starts active, bounded render blocks remain finite until completion, and clear/re-attach or a different output group remains an immediate swap.

commit_loudness_peq snapshots the previous immutable PEQ only for same-output-group replacement and starts a fixed-capacity 120 ms equal-power crossfade; render uses stack-only buffers, fails closed for blocks above 23040 frames, and clears transition state after retirement.

limitations: This is deterministic user-space DSP evidence; it does not prove physical sink delivery, subjective click-free listening, ISO 226 conformance, WaveRT behavior, driver installation, HLK validation, or signing.
The provenance digest binds this manifest to the staged source set; it does not independently attest that declared commands ran.

The first verify invocation completed its build/tests before an unrelated retry hit a transient object-file lock in the shared .local/build directory; the recorded CTest result is from that completed build tree.
